description: BITRE freight statistical periodicals Freightline, Trainline, Waterline and Avline is a group of 4 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by BITRE. Members: Avline No 2, April 2003; Freightline; Trainline statistical reports; Waterline. Example entry: The first of two articles in this issue is the January airport charges update, which expands on the airport charges article in the inaugural edition of Avline. Airport operator charges at all airports were effectively unchanged, after a retrospective adjustment at Adelaide. Coverage is Australia and its states and territories, 1990 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2026-07-09. Files and pages listed: CSV, HTML, PDF (12 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
